description:
Goal
Create product producers for local semantic/runtime-demand information without reusing DeriveRuntimeDemand as a job or recreating SemanticClosed under a new name.

Required shape
- Extract reusable local helper logic from DeriveRuntimeDemand into product-safe functions.
- RuntimeDemandProduct(E) reads only the facts/products needed for E and returns a demanded-value product plus named product waits for callees/callable targets.
- OutgoingInputEdgesProduct(E) records caller-owned outgoing call-argument and callable-capture edges into PullSession.
- Direct callable demand for operator refs stays direct; escaped or opaque callable demand remains explicit when actually demanded.
- Recursive demand behavior must use monotone per-product/SCC-local convergence, not root iteration over all runtime-demand facts.

Signal
For fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz, the product path reports direct callable reducer demand for Kernel.+/2, no first-class callable boundary demand, and the same public callsite types as the current activations dump.

Removal target
New path does not call Job::DeriveRuntimeDemand or SealSemanticClosure. Existing jobs may remain only for the legacy path until the final deletion tickets.

Verification
Targeted unit/product tests for direct lambda/operator callable demand; no-dump telemetry for 00181 with product events; existing compiler2 runtime-demand tests remain green.
title: Pull path: port semantic and runtime-demand helpers into products
